conclusions: Processor performance variation coincided with a late multi-stage slowdown and a slower independent arithmetic probe
Changing only AC minimum processor performance to 100% stabilized observed performance but did not eliminate record timing variation; reversal did not reproduce the same severe frequency drop
Direct GC/JIT pauses cannot explain most late slow frames in these diagnostic captures

The subsequent isolated pair contains no Codex/ChatGPT, VS Code or Epic among readable process observations; A0 late slowdown co-occurs with all-core performance falling to 67-69 and the independent arithmetic probe slowing from about 0.050 to 0.080 ms, then recovering together
B4 late record P95 remains about 0.385-0.390 ms in the isolated pair; conditions differ from A0 so this is not a valid speedup ratio

The isolated A0 power experiment held late CPU P95 at about 0.495-0.500 ms; restoring the original scheme reproduced slow windows and processor performance drops, supporting a common controlled power condition for a new full calibration
The underlying trigger and all residual variability remain unexplained; the three instrumented A0 runs are not a complete performance acceptance population
